# RADAR / AID-DRAS Experimental Results Directory

This directory stores the quantitative experimental results generated by the RADAR pipeline (`bigdata/`).

## Expected Artifacts (Generated by `./run_pipeline.sh all`)

| Artifact Path | Description | Source Pipeline Script |
|---|---|---|
| `district_day_panel/` | PySpark district-day panel Parquet files | `bigdata/etl/build_district_panel.py` |
| `district_static_deficits.csv` | Normalized Census-2011 deficit indicators | `bigdata/ddrps/compute_deficits.py` |
| `risk_panel/` | Raw ML model predictions (RF, GBT, LogReg) | `bigdata/models/train_risk_model.py` |
| `risk_panel_calibrated/` | Isotonic calibrated probabilities | `bigdata/models/calibrate_conformal.py` |
| `conformal_settings.json` | Nonconformity quantiles $\hat{q}$ and 90% coverage verification | `bigdata/models/calibrate_conformal.py` |
| `model_metrics.csv` | ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier score across splits | `bigdata/models/train_risk_model.py` |
| `ddrps_ranking.csv` | Per-district hazard vs priority scores and ranks | `bigdata/ddrps/score_ddrps.py` |
| `ranking_metrics.json` | Spearman $\rho$, MARC, and Top-5 overlap stats | `bigdata/ddrps/score_ddrps.py` |
| `allocation_results.csv` | Per-event stock allocation and unmet demand | `bigdata/allocation/optimize_prepositioning.py` |
| `validation_summary.json` | Summary of unmet demand across strategies | `bigdata/allocation/evaluate_on_events.py` |
| `scalability_results.csv` | Scale-up and scale-out throughput benchmarks | `bigdata/benchmarks/benchmark_scalability.py` |

## Reproducibility Protocol

To generate all experimental results from raw data:
```bash
./run_pipeline.sh download
./run_pipeline.sh all
python bigdata/research/generate_report.py
```
